newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 383,300 MT were 28 percent above the previous week and 37 percent above the 4-week average. Major increases for Mexico (151,300 MT), Taiwan (108,700 MT, including declaration of U.S. origin for optional origin sales of 108,000 MT), Israel (60,000 MT), and China (52,500 MT, reflects 2,500 new sales, 50,000 destination changes) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (63,000 MT).

Exports of 491,600 MT bettered the previous week's level by 70 percent and the 4-week average by 40 percent. The primary destinations were Mexico (101,200 MT), Japan (99,600 MT), Indonesia (58,100 MT), and China (52,500 MT).
